args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger/batteries
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Medications and prescriptions
- First aid kit
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes/sandals
- Water shoes for beach activities
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments and socks
- One slightly dressier outfit for the Luau (June 16)

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case/dry bag
- Beach bag
- Flip flops
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Sturdy hiking shoes (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Hiking socks
- Daypack/backpack
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
- Insect repellent
- Water bottle
- Trail snacks

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash/soap
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Skincare products
- Makeup (optional)
- Lip balm with SPF

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader for relaxation days
- Travel pillow and eye mask
- Small backpack for day trips
- Umbrella or rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Ziplock bags for wet items or storage

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor visit (June 14): Respectful attire, camera
- North Shore road trip (June 15): Cooler for drinks/snacks
- Polynesian Cultural Center Luau (June 16): Hawaiian shirt/dress if desired
- Hotel spa day (June 17): Spa attire if required
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18): Quick-dry clothing
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19): Reusable shopping bags
